a1
The famine grew worse. When the grain was gone, Jacob said: go back and buy us more food.
a2
Judah said: send the boy with me. I will be responsible for him. If I do not bring him back, let me bear the blame forever.
b1
Jacob sent gifts, double the silver, and Benjamin. He prayed: may God Almighty grant you mercy before the man.
b2
Joseph saw Benjamin with them, and ordered a meal for these men.
c1
The brothers feared the silver in their sacks. The steward said: peace to you, do not be afraid. Your God put treasure in your sacks. Then Simeon came out.
c2
Joseph came home, saw Benjamin, and said: God be gracious to you, my son.
d1
Overcome with feeling, Joseph hurried out, and wept in a private room.
d2
Then he washed his face and had the meal served. Benjamin's portion was five times larger.
h1
Judah once said: let us sell him. Now he said: I will be responsible for him.
h2
The chapter does not say why he changed. It shows what he risked.
h3
Character shows in what we carry for others.
h4
Today, take responsibility for someone who depends on you.
i
Who is depending on you right now?
